9th. JANUARY, 2025
WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT
(Chapter 277)
WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH (WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH OFFICERS)
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2025
In exercise of the powers conferred by sections 28 and 64 of the Workplace
Safety and Health Act, the Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister, with the
approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby makes the
following Regulations -
Citation and commencement
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Workplace Safety and Health
(Workplace Safety and Health Officers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 and shall
be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2025.
Insertion of new regulation IA into Rg 5 of Chapter 277
2. The Workplace Safety and Health (Workplace Safety and Health Officers)
Regulations, in these Regulations referred to as the principal Regulations,
is amended by inserting the following new regulation immediately after
regulation 1 -
"Interpretation
lA. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires -
"hazardous substance" means any hazardous substance specified m
Division 2 of Part 2 of Schedule 5 to the Act.".
Amendment of Schedule 2
3. Schedule 2 to the principal Regulations is amended -
fa} by deleting paragraph 2 and by substituting the following new
paragraph therefor -
"2. Premises used for processing any hazardous substance, including
exploration, exploitation, extraction, drilling intervention, handling,
storage or disposal of the hazardous substances and includes premises
used for the provision of -
fa} offshore accommodation for persons working on another
premises, whether connected to that premises or not; and

{b) services and maintenance of the premises.";
(b) by adding the following new paragraph -
"5. Premises used in the operation, maintenance and provision of any
public utility.".
Made this 8th. day of Rejab, 1446 Hijriah corresponding to the
8th. day of January, 2025.
PERIN DATU LAILARAJA MAJOR GENERAL (R) DATO PADUKA SERI
AWANG HAJI HALBI BIN HAJI MOHD YUSSOF
Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister and Minister of Defence II.
